title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper KAMI: Communication-Avoiding General Matrix Multiplication within a Single GPU
problem: Artifact reproducibility evaluation of published SC research requires systematic assessment against established criteria. This report documents artifact evaluation for KAMI GPU GEMM paper.
motivation: SC reproducibility initiative ensures published research is reproducible and artifacts are properly documented. Independent artifact evaluation provides verification and enables community adoption.
method: An independent evaluator runs the KAMI GPU GEMM code to verify it produces the same results the authors published, checking against SC25's standard criteria for research artifacts. The evaluation confirms the code works as described, has no hidden dependencies, and achieves the claimed speedups on GPU hardware. This independent verification demonstrates that the research can be reproduced and validated by others.
key_novelty: Independent confirmation that KAMI's GPU GEMM code successfully reproduces its published results when evaluated according to SC25 standards.
contributions: Independent artifact evaluation for communication-avoiding GEMM paper
limitations: Reproducibility report focused on artifact evaluation, not algorithmic novelty
Specific findings and issues not summarized
